Hello, this is Ray Collins, the site supervisor. Here is the plan for tomorrow. Karen is our field engineer this month, and this is how her day works. She starts at six thirty, and she reads the schedule with me in the office. After that she inspects the north tunnel with two colleagues from the crew. She does not write the report in the morning. She writes it at four o'clock, and she sends it to me before five. She carries the radio all day, so call her any time. Thank you, and have a safe shift.

Hi Giovanna, it is Karen. You asked me about my day here, so here it is. I am a field engineer, so I work outside most of the time. My day starts with the schedule: I read it, and then I talk to my supervisor. My first task is always the same. I inspect the tunnel wall with the crew, every morning, before the machines start. My colleague Tom is different. He works in the office, and he does not go down the tunnel. He prepares the daily report, and I send him the numbers at four. See you on Friday.
